identifiedRisks.description: Project relies on groundbreaking and unproven special effects, including a large-scale rotating centrifuge set, extensive zero-gravity wire-work, and the 'Stargate' slit-scan sequence. Technical failures could cause significant delays and budget overruns.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Allocate substantial R&D budget and time. Hire top-tier SFX/VFX supervisors and engineering teams. Build and test prototypes well before principal photography.

identifiedRisks.description: Scenes involve multiple wild and trained animals, including a trained lion, in close proximity to actors. Poses a significant safety risk to cast and crew and risk of shooting delays.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Engage experienced, certified animal wranglers and a dedicated safety coordinator. Adhere strictly to animal welfare guidelines. Schedule animal scenes with buffer days.

identifiedRisks.description: Numerous large, complex, and futuristic sets are required (Discovery Centrifuge, Space Station, Moon Base). Construction timelines and costs are substantial.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Detailed pre-visualization and architectural plans. Lock designs early. Secure large soundstages well in advance. Multiple construction crews may be needed.

identifiedRisks.description: Extremely long and complex shooting schedule (145 days) with multiple distinct production phases (Africa, Space Station, Discovery, Stargate). A delay in one phase will cascade and impact the entire production.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Modular scheduling. Build contingency days into each major location/set block. Empower a highly experienced 1st AD and UPM.

identifiedRisks.description: Unprecedented number of complex VFX shots (205+) requiring techniques like front projection, model photography, and optical printing. Post-production timeline is a major risk.
identifiedRisks.mitigation: Integrate VFX supervisor from pre-production. Begin VFX work during principal photography. Secure contracts with multiple VFX vendors to distribute workload.
